notes: Inner thoughts. Every reply now carries what one to three characters in the scene are privately thinking, in their own inner voice, sometimes the opposite of what they said out loud. They're hidden by default; turn on Settings → Show thoughts to see them as little 💭 lines under each reply. Turning it on also shows thoughts from earlier replies. Nobody in the story ever knows another person's thoughts, including your character. In progressive story mode, unknown people's thoughts show as ???.
